failure.stage: first UNet spatial attention before a generated frame
failure.cause: The minimal environment omitted optional xFormers, so official CrossAttention materialized the full attention matrix.

resolution: Use PyTorch 2.7 native scaled_dot_product_attention for the same unmasked spatial attention instead of downloading an older xFormers wheel whose Blackwell support is uncertain. Keep temporal relative-position attention unchanged. Canonical retry is v2.
